subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Engineers changed the subway design slightly and created a small underground display near the station.”?
options: When the shop first opened, she used it to listen to music while making noodles.
When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.
The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely above it.
During repairs at an old train station, workers found a wall painting hidden behind layers of paint.

本文可直接核對「Engineers changed the subway design slightly and created a small underground display near the station. When the station opened, commuters could see…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

When the station opened, commuters could see the wall…」，答案為「When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.」。
